candidates.violated_requirement: The Gray-to-binary conversion should use the correct input bits. Changing bin_out[3] to use gray_wire[2] instead of gray_wire[3] and removing the dependency on bin_out[3] in the second XOR operation will cause incorrect binary values to be calculated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires correct Gray-to-binary conversion in step 2 of the process.
